Seeds tenant/organization/admin-user/BCrypt-hashed password/program/class/question/blueprint/session/media upload through the live MinIO presigned URL (MINIO_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT fix, see deviations).

2 app replicas behind gateway, both backed by the same pg-monolith database; re-ran the seed + attempt flow across the pair to confirm no replica-local state (Docker's embedded DNS round-robins between them).

commands.command: git stash push -- docker-compose.services.yml docker-compose.deploy.yml gateway/src/main/resources/application.yml pom.xml Dockerfile ; git stash pop
commands.note: Rollback rehearsal: stashing the cutover's config changes cleanly restores the pre-cutover gateway/compose/pom state and pops back without conflict, proving a `git revert` of the eventual cutover commit is mechanically safe.

commands.command: mvn -pl app -am -DskipTests validate && mvn -pl app -am -DskipTests compile
commands.note: Reactor resolves and the app module compiles after removing the 10 services/* entries from pom.xml's <modules> block and deleting services/ from disk.

coverage: Full runtime boot of the modular monolith (app + gateway) against real Postgres, Redis, RabbitMQ, MinIO and Mailpit — the first genuine runtime verification of the entire migration; every prior phase (01–10) was unit-test-only per their own Quality and Testing State sections.
Flyway V1–V13 clean-install verified twice on an empty schema.
All 9 client-facing gateway route prefixes verified to reach the single app container with the pre-existing Path predicates unchanged (StripPrefix=2 added).

Full business flow: identity → tenancy/enrollment → itembank/assessment → session → attempt (objective + AI-scored) → scoring → reporting (visibility gate, publish, 10-90 formula) → notification email, exercised via the existing seed-e2e.ps1 script plus manual curl for the attempt/scoring/reporting/notification leg the script doesn't cover.
2-replica horizontal scaling behind the gateway sharing one Postgres, confirmed via Docker's embedded DNS round-robin — no explicit load balancer config required.
Rollback rehearsal via git stash/pop on every cutover-modified file, standing in for a future `git revert` of the cutover commit.

bugs_found_and_fixed.summary: ConflictingBeanDefinitionException: com.pte.attempt.internal.service.ProctorCommandService and com.pte.proctoring.internal.service.ProctorCommandService collide on Spring's default (simple-class-name) bean name.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Renamed proctoring's class (file + class + all references + test) to ProctorCommandDispatchService.
bugs_found_and_fixed.caught_by: Full ApplicationContext boot only — no unit test in any phase boots the full context.

bugs_found_and_fixed.summary: Same collision pattern for RabbitMqConfig — both scoring and notification modules defined a @Configuration class with the same simple name.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Renamed to ScoringRabbitMqConfig / NotificationRabbitMqConfig; proactively scanned the whole app module for other duplicate simple class names and confirmed the 2 remaining duplicates (OrganizationNotFoundException, Skill) are not Spring beans.

bugs_found_and_fixed.summary: MinIO presigned upload URLs unreachable from the host: MINIO_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT had inherited the docker-internal MINIO_ENDPOINT value (http://minio:9000), which a host-side PowerShell process can't resolve.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Set MINIO_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT explicitly to http://localhost:9000 in the app compose block, distinct from the internal MINIO_ENDPOINT — matching the pre-existing distinction documented since Phase 04.
bugs_found_and_fixed.caught_by: seed-e2e.ps1's file-upload step against the live container stack.

bugs_found_and_fixed.summary: RabbitTemplate couldn't serialize EmailJob/AiScoringJob records (IllegalArgumentException from the default SimpleMessageConverter) — each module's own MessageConverter bean was only wired into its RabbitListenerContainerFactory (consume side), never into the auto-configured RabbitTemplate (publish side).
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Centralized into one @Primary MessageConverter bean in com.pte.shared.config.RabbitMessageConverterConfig; removed the per-module duplicate beans; container-factory methods now resolve the shared bean by type.
bugs_found_and_fixed.caught_by: Live RabbitMQ publish during the attempt-submit → scoring flow.

bugs_found_and_fixed.summary: Enrollment notifications silently produced zero NotificationLog rows and zero emails with no exception anywhere: a plain @Transactional (REQUIRED) method called from inside a @TransactionalEventListener AFTER_COMMIT callback silently joined the stale/already-committing transaction resource instead of opening a new one — save() returned a real ID in Java but the INSERT never reached Postgres.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Switched NotificationDispatchService.dispatch()/dispatchTo() to @Transactional(propagation = Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW); verified via direct psql query and real Mailpit delivery.
bugs_found_and_fixed.caught_by: Manual enrollment → email walkthrough against live Postgres/Mailpit; not reproducible with mocked repositories.

deviations: No new unit tests written for Phase 11 — this phase's acceptance criteria explicitly require runtime evidence, not additional unit coverage (phase-11-cutover.md: "không coi compile/unit test là đủ").

The legacy 4-cell Postgres definitions (pg-core/pg-exam/pg-live/pg-async) in the base docker-compose.yml were deliberately left untouched — out of scope for this pass; a more consequential infra/data change than the stated Acceptance criteria require, in a real hosted-demo environment's config file.

Mechanical quality receipt not issued for this phase (same pte-doc/pte-api multi-repo boundary limitation noted in every prior phase's Quality and Testing State) — not applicable in the same way here since Phase 11's gate is runtime evidence, not a ck:quality --gate pass, but flagged for consistency with prior phases.
